beatLines.text: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Ingrid ONeill. Fishing guide. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Knife roll, Tasting Spoon, Dog tags, Carpenter's square, Mixtape. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Kipngetich a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 5)

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
SYSTEM: "DEMONSTRATION. Give me that — Trail compass. WATCH."
💛 You hold Trail compass and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Green Thumb)

💛 You hold Trail compass. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Kipngetich opens the pantry wide: 4× Rice, 1× Fish catch (smoked), 1× Fish catch (smoked). Marcus, David eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−1,504 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 FEASTED ×2.03 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.
